name: write_file
description:
Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Missing parent directories are created automatically. Use absolute paths. When the user does not specify a location, default to the current working directory from the system context. Example: {"path":"/output/profile.html","content":"

Hello

"}

path.description: Absolute path of the file to write. Default to the current working directory when no path is given.

content.description: Content to write to the file.

append.description: If true, append content to the file instead of overwriting.
